source: Public X (Twitter) posts retrieved 13 Nov 2026 via the X search and recent-counts APIs, anonymised (no usernames or author IDs retained), for illustration only in the Live X demo tab. This live sample is not part of the evaluated dissertation results, which use the UCI influenza outbreak dataset (Zhao, 2015). There is no full-archive counts tool in the available X connector (only get_posts_counts_recent, which covers the last 7 days). search_posts_all was used for the 14 Oct–13 Nov post sample and for mid-month outbreak-signal daily volumes; that search endpoint caps each call at 25 posts even if a higher max_results is requested. The X search API does not accept since: in the query string; windows were sent as start_time/end_time. Self-reported illness phrases were paired with flu or respiratory context (flu OR fever OR cough OR 'sore throat' OR chills). Confounders (COVID, RSV, stomach flu) and avian influenza (bird flu / H5N1) are tagged separately for filtering and are not mixed into seasonal-flu outbreak totals.

get_posts_counts_recent_window.notes: First and last official buckets are partial UTC days.

limits.max_results_note: Requests for 100 results were lowered by the API to 25, the most one call can return.

outbreak_signals_30_day_from_paginated_s.coverage: Daily totals for 14–27 Oct 2026 were built by paginating search_posts_all. Days marked complete=true are exhausted pages (full daily totals). Days marked complete=false are lower bounds only. 6–13 Nov official totals come from get_posts_counts_recent and should be used for that week. 28 Oct–5 Nov were not fully paginated (call budget); no invented values are supplied for those days.
